summary: `docs/CLI.md` § `flume tick` states a cause per code that nothing reads back — the standing pin compares the set of codes and nothing else

per.section: Derived state is computed, never restated beside its source

acceptance: each `flume tick` exit code's sentences on the page are read against that arm's labelled cause, through the reader already scoped to one code
pins: docs/CLI.md's flume tick section states each exit code's cause under the phrase its arm is labelled with
notes: Second half of the 46446dc9 ruling: the page is pinned against the producer's map, never against the help text — two prose copies agree while both are wrong (`.claude/rules/engineering.md`, *A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote*). The reader exists; what it lacked was a source of truth for what each sentence must say.
